name: Tinga de Pollo
vibe: smoky chipotle-braised chicken piled on crisp tostadas — weeknight, one pot, gone in minutes.

ingredients.qty: 2–3, chopped + a spoon of the adobo

steps.text: Slice ½ cebolla thin. Warm 1 tbsp aceite in the comal, medium.
Cook the cebolla until soft and just golden — don't rush it.
Stir in the chipotles en adobo, chopped, plus a spoon of the adobo.
Add the shredded pollo and a splash of caldo. Simmer until it drinks it in.
Season with sal. Warm the tostadas on a dry comal until they catch.
Pile the tinga on tostadas; finish with crema and crumbled queso fresco.

finish: Eat right away, standing up if you have to — tostadas go soft fast. A squeeze of lime and a few slices of avocado if you've got them.
notes: Out of tostadas? Warm corn tortillas and fold it into tacos instead.
The tinga base keeps 3 days in the fridge and gets better — shred more pollo into it for tomorrow's tortas.
This finishes your crema and your tostadas; the checklist after will offer to mark them down.
